name: manual_05c055
claim: git merge-file -p ours base theirs can literally duplicate an identical textual addition when both 'ours' and 'theirs' independently added the exact same content at slightly different anchor points relative to 'base' -- inspect merge-tool preview output for back-to-back duplicate blocks before promoting or applying it; re-running an apply step that rebuilds the preview directory from scratch wipes any manual de-duplication, so it must be redone if the target sha changes.

decisions.notes: Caught in learn.py's 3-way-merge preview during an agentic-stack vendor blend: a UTF-8 sys.stdout.reconfigure block appeared twice, identical, back-to-back, because PT's 'ours' and upstream's 'theirs' had each independently added the same fix at different anchor lines.

rationale: Caught in learn.py's 3-way-merge preview during an agentic-stack vendor blend: a UTF-8 sys.stdout.reconfigure block appeared twice, identical, back-to-back, because PT's 'ours' and upstream's 'theirs' had each independently added the same fix at different anchor lines.
